description: Election Commission - Yogarasan Tharasan was Elected as a Member of the Navithanveli Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government authority (Navithanveli Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for local government positions, including the declaration of a newly elected member to fill a vacancy caused by non-attendance. This falls directly under Election Gazettes (Type 7), which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations of elected members for government bodies.
